quarterly_data.quarter: Linktel Technologies results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Zhang Jian (Hubei listed companies' collective 2025 results briefing): overall capacity utilisation was about 72.1% at the end of 2025; the company has long-term relationships and strategic agreements with suppliers and, based on orders on hand and expected demand, has stocked key raw materials in advance and locked in capacity. It is expanding 800G and 1.6T capacity step by step across its China and Malaysia bases; the Malaysia plant focuses on R&D and manufacturing of 800G, 1.6T and other next-generation high-speed modules, and board secretary Xiao Ming said investment in the overseas manufacturing base will keep increasing.

quarterly_data.quarter: Linktel Technologies results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Zhang Jian (collective 2025 results briefing): the 1.6T module has gone through several rounds of iteration with several technical paths in parallel and is with several customers for testing, with validation going smoothly; the company will follow customer validation and introduction to move it into volume production. The share of 800G in revenue is gradually rising and the product mix is shifting to 800G, 1.6T and other high-speed products for AI and data centers; in his view the 800G-and-above module market keeps growing with global data-center and cloud expansion.
